limits: One model is one preprocessor configuration. Every claim here is conditional on the configuration that was analyzed; variant coverage is unsolved and is not implied.
Static call graphs are unsound. Virtual dispatch, function pointers and inlining mean any reachability or blast-radius number is a lower bound, not a fact.
